units.source_text: 回头望去，只见昏暗的公园树丛上方耸立着仁王门、五重塔和观音堂的黑影。

en.t: When she looked back, she could see only the dark silhouettes of the Niomon gate, the five storied pagoda, and the Kannon hall rising above the dim trees of the park.

units.source_text: 在那黑暗的深层，谁也不曾想到竟有数百人露宿在外。

en.t: No one would have imagined that deep within that darkness several hundred people were sleeping outdoors.

units.source_text: 夜那静悄悄的重量，仿佛一声不响地压迫着大地。

en.t: The silent weight of the night seemed to press down on the earth without making a sound.

units.source_text: 町子一反常态地感到在隐蔽处和长椅上露宿的人的悲哀情调，似乎渗透到她那胳膊腿整个都露在外面的排练服里。

en.t: Unusually for her, Machiko felt as if the sadness of the people sleeping in hidden corners and on benches were seeping into her rehearsal clothes, which left her arms and legs entirely exposed.

units.source_text: 她的新恋人——那个少年无疑也坐在这些长椅中的一张上。

en.t: Her new lover, that boy, was surely sitting on one of these benches too.
